title: Shadow Pilot Risk Register (PASS 41)

risks.risk: Sensitive owner/customer data leaks into fixtures or responses
risks.mitigation: Redaction guide §7 checklist enforced in PASS 42 fixtures; PASS 39 rawTextHidden/piiStripped refines; DB test asserts PII/raw-text suppression
workspace-scoped reads; owner-*-read.db.test.ts isolation assertions; PASS 42 DB sim adds wsA/wsB isolation
recovery + public-signal Zod refines (noMoney); PASS 40 forbidden-copy tests; evaluation matrix F3
thrive gate blocked until stabilization proven (survival-recovery + recovery-status refines); scenario E/F expectations

risks.risk: Unsafe external action becomes completable / auto-offered
risks.mitigation: BLOCK_UNSAFE_ACTION/MONITOR_ONLY non-completable; no outreach/spend/tender path exists; DB sim asserts blocked

risks.risk: Material action completes without owner approval
risks.mitigation: OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED enforced by verified capability (actorRole from verifiedCapabilities); PASS 25; DB sim non-owner block
PASS 40 no-overload proof (component + browser); PASS 42 asserts payload low-load

risks.risk: Clean/missing data produces a fabricated decision
risks.mitigation: NONE / missing-data on empty data (now-view/recovery/public-signals); scenario G control

risks.risk: Conservative archetype under-prioritises a real public signal
risks.mitigation: interpreter only downgrades, never fabricates; documented restriction; validation-required surfaced to owner

risks.risk: Owner must re-key data OpsIQ already holds (workload not reduced)
risks.mitigation: cockpit reads server-computed payload; evaluation F10 checks re-keying; workload reduction module
risks.note: true workload reduction is measured, not assumed; recorded honestly by owner

risks.risk: Overbuilt importer / accidental live integration during PASS 42
risks.mitigation: PASS 42 uses a deterministic test harness to populate minimum records; no live importer; frozen-scope guard

risks.risk: Real owner data used before redaction
risks.mitigation: PASS 42 uses OWNER_STYLE_SYNTHETIC_SHADOW_FIXTURES only; real data must be redacted per PASS 41 first

risks.risk: Generic advice instead of governed routed action
risks.mitigation: every recommendation resolves to a ProcessExecutionTask route or a gate; evaluation F12

risks.risk: Unrecoverable case is dressed as recoverable
risks.mitigation: survival planner emits RESTRUCTURE_REVIEW_REQUIRED / CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN_REVIEW_REQUIRED honestly; scenario H

remainingRisksBeforeLivePilot: No real redacted owner data has been tested yet (shadow uses synthetic owner-style fixtures).
True owner workload reduction is only measurable with a real owner in the loop.
Archetype fidelity for public signals is conservative until owner business context is supplied.
A live pilot would require: real redacted data, an owner operating the cockpit, and a fresh safety pass before any non-shadow use.
